# The dock's default tear-out route has no example and no e2e witness

## Context

The Adoption guide, as corrected by #19608, documents the engine's default tear-out route: with `useSharedWorkers` and `enableDockTearOutLifecycle`, `Workspace#openTearOutVessel` reopens the host's own page with `?tearout=<itemId>`, and the application only boots an empty viewport there. "You do not have to write window-opening code to use the default route."

Nothing in the repository runs that route. On 2026-10-11 at `a2a7d5779b`:
- `enableDockTearOutLifecycle` appears only in `src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs` and `apps/workstation/view/VesselWorkspace.mjs`. The Workstation overrides the opener with its own `popout`/`workspace` routes (`apps/workstation/BootIntent.mjs`).
- No app, example or spec reads the `tearout` parameter.
- The unit (`DockWorkspace.spec.mjs`) and component (`component/apps/dock-popout`) fixtures stub `openTearOutVessel`.

#19608's evidence was a source comparison, so the guide's claim had not been run either.

## The Problem

An adopter following the guide has no running reference for the route it teaches, and the route itself can regress unseen: no test drives the base opener, the empty boot target or the return on close. The stage-2 blog post (#19614) needs an app where its windows code runs.

## The Architectural Reality

I measured the route headless, with an untracked four-file app on the default opener (Chromium, dev server, real mouse):
- pop-out through the header action opens `…/index.html?tearout=metrics`, and the window shows a pane with the same id (`neo-dock-pane-2`) while the main window drops the tab;
- closing that window through its unload path returns `neo-dock-pane-2` to the main window.

**Correction (2026-10-11, Sophie's RA-1 on #19617):** an id match is not instance proof. A declaration keeps its generated id, so a pane re-created from it matches too. The PR's witness is a draft typed into a Notes pane, which survives both hops and fails a re-create mutation.

A close that skips the unload path (Playwright's default `page.close()`) returns nothing. That is a probe artifact, not product behaviour: the App Worker never hears that the window went away.

`Workspace#reparentDockPane` adds the live pane to `Neo.apps[windowId].mainView`, so the empty viewport is the whole application obligation. A spec without `neuralLink` is Brain-free, and `test/playwright/e2e/dashboard` is in hosted CI's `RUN_PATHS` (`buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs`).

## The Fix

- `examples/dashboard/tearOut/`: `app.mjs`, `index.html`, `neo-config.json` (`useSharedWorkers`), a `Viewport` that mounts nothing when its URL has `tearout`, and a `Workspace` with three panes, `enableDockTearOutLifecycle: true` and a `crossWindowSortGroup`. It is the sibling of `examples/dashboard/crossWindow`, minus every custom seam.
- `test/playwright/e2e/dashboard/DockTearOutDefaultRoute.spec.mjs`, a plain Playwright spec: type a draft into a pane, pop it out through the header action, assert the URL and the draft in the new window, close it through the unload path, and assert the draft is home.
- One sentence in `DockLayoutsAdoption.md`'s tear-out section pointing at the example as the default route's runnable reference.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The example runs the default route with no window-opening code: its only window-specific code is the `tearout` check in `Viewport`. (#19617, merged as `2542683224`)
- [x] The e2e spec passes locally ten times in a row, and in hosted CI. (10/10 locally; hosted e2e shard 1/3 ran it green on #19617, and three mutations fail it)
- [x] The Adoption guide links the example from its tear-out section.

## Out of Scope

- A portal showcase card for the example.
- Drag-based tear-out (`DemoBDockTearOutNL.spec.mjs` covers that path).
- Engine changes.
